heading: top-left
name: 滿版格線網格＋格內置中圖文＋置中文字連結
desc: 橫跨整個畫面寬的三欄網格，格與格之間只用格線分隔、沒有間距；每格內圖片置中、文字置中，圖片統一尺寸，文字對齊。網格下方置中一個帶箭頭與底線的文字連結。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方靠左放標題組，對齊頁面內容寬度；標題組包含標題（可多行），標題後方可緊接一段小字次要文字，和標題排在同一行、底部對齊，沒有時省略；標題列的右側不放其他元素。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，每列三格、各格等寬等高；網格橫跨整個畫面寬，貼齊畫面左右邊緣，每一格之間有格線，網格上下緣也各有一條橫線，格線延伸到畫面兩端，項目之間沒有間距。每個項目無外框：上半部是圖片，所有項目的圖片尺寸與比例統一（橫式），約佔格寬七成、左右置中，同一列下方的文字起點對齊；圖片下方置中排列標題（可多行），標題上方可放小標籤，下方可放次要文字，沒有時省略；格內上下留大片空白。網格下方置中可放一個文字連結（文字右側接一個長箭頭，下方有一條底線），不做成實心按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：標題組在上方靠左，網格改為每列一個項目，只顯示前四個項目，其餘隱藏；格與格之間的橫向格線保留並橫跨畫面寬；格內圖片放大到約佔格寬八成多，仍然置中，文字置中的排列不變，格內上下仍留大片空白；文字連結接在第四個項目之後，位於區塊最下方置中。滑過格子時底色改變的效果在觸控裝置上取消。

en.name: Full-bleed grid with grid lines, centered cells and a centered text link
en.desc: A three-column grid spanning the full screen width, with cells separated only by grid lines and no gap; each cell centers its image and text, images share one size and the text aligns. A centered text link with an arrow and underline sits below the grid.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left, within the page content width; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally followed directly by a short piece of small secondary text on the same line, bottom-aligned with the title; omit it when there is no content. Place nothing else on the right side of the title row. Below the heading group, multiple items form a grid with three cells per row, all cells equal in width and height; the grid spans the full screen width, flush with the left and right edges of the screen, with grid lines between every cell and a horizontal line along the top and bottom of the grid, all lines running to both edges of the screen, and no gap between items. Each item has no frame: its upper part is an image; all items use images of the same size and aspect ratio (landscape), taking about seventy percent of the cell width and horizontally centered, so the text below starts at the same height across a row. Below the image, center a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above it and secondary text below it; omit them when there is no content. Leave generous empty space at the top and bottom inside each cell. Optionally center a text link below the grid (text followed by a long arrow on its right, with an underline beneath), not a solid button; omit it when there is no content.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the heading group stays at the top, aligned left, and the grid becomes one item per row, showing only the first four items and hiding the rest; the horizontal grid lines between cells are kept and span the screen width; the image inside each cell grows to about eighty-plus percent of the cell width and stays centered, the centered text stays the same, still with generous empty space at the top and bottom of each cell; the text link follows the fourth item, centered at the very bottom of the section. The hover background change on cells is removed on touch devices.

extras.name: 滑過格子時底色改變
extras.prompt: 滑鼠移到網格的某一格上時，整格的底色略微改變，移開後恢復，提示這一格可以點擊。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消這個效果，點擊格子直接進入連結。

en.name: Cell background changes on hover
en.prompt: When the mouse moves over a cell in the grid, the whole cell's background changes slightly and returns when the mouse leaves, signaling that the cell is clickable.
en.mobile: On touch devices this effect is removed; tapping a cell opens its link directly.
